## Load Packages
```{r}
setwd("~/R Studio/NSAS Herring/NSAS-Herring")

# Load required libraries
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(elevatr)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggnewscale)
library(grid)
```

```{r}
# Load shapefile
marine_components <- st_read("data raw/components_shp/components.shp", quiet = TRUE)

# Ensure WGS84 projection
marine_components <- st_transform(marine_components, crs = 4326)

# Calculate map extent with adjusted padding
bbox <- st_bbox(marine_components)
padding_east <- 8
padding_west <- 5
padding_ns <- 0.5

map_extent <- list(
  lon_min = bbox["xmin"] - padding_west,
  lon_max = bbox["xmax"] + padding_east,
  lat_min = bbox["ymin"] - padding_ns,
  lat_max = bbox["ymax"] + padding_ns)

cat("Map extent:\n")
cat("  Longitude:", round(map_extent$lon_min, 1), "to", round(map_extent$lon_max, 1), "\n")
cat("  Latitude:", round(map_extent$lat_min, 1), "to", round(map_extent$lat_max, 1), "\n")

# Download bathymetry data
cat("\nDownloading bathymetry data...\n")

# Create extent polygon for data download
extent_poly <- st_polygon(list(matrix(c(
  map_extent$lon_min, map_extent$lat_min,
  map_extent$lon_max, map_extent$lat_min,
  map_extent$lon_max, map_extent$lat_max,
  map_extent$lon_min, map_extent$lat_max,
  map_extent$lon_min, map_extent$lat_min
), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE))) %>%
  st_sfc(crs = 4326) %>%
  st_sf()

# Get elevation data (includes bathymetry)
elevation_data <- get_elev_raster(extent_poly, z = 6)

# Convert to data frame and process elevation data
bathy_df <- raster::as.data.frame(elevation_data, xy = TRUE)
names(bathy_df) <- c("longitude", "latitude", "elevation")

# Separate land and sea data
bathy_sea <- bathy_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(elevation), elevation <= 0) %>%
  mutate(depth = abs(elevation),
         depth_capped = pmin(depth, 1000))  # Cap depth for color scaling

topo_land <- bathy_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(elevation), elevation > 0) %>%
  mutate(elevation_capped = pmin(elevation, 1000))  # Cap elevation for color scaling

if (nrow(bathy_sea) == 0) {
  stop("No bathymetry data available for this region")}

cat("Bathymetry data successfully processed!\n")
cat("Depth range:", min(bathy_sea$depth), "to", max(bathy_sea$depth), "meters\n")

if (nrow(topo_land) > 0) {
  cat("Topography data successfully processed!\n")
  cat("Elevation range:", min(topo_land$elevation), "to", max(topo_land$elevation), "meters\n")}

# Get coastline data
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Calculate component centroids for labels
component_centroids <- marine_components %>%
  group_by(component) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(
    centroid = st_centroid(geometry),
    lon = st_coordinates(centroid)[,1],
    lat = st_coordinates(centroid)[,2])

# Create bathymetric map with corrected layer hierarchy
bathymetric_map <- ggplot() +
  # Layer 1: Add bathymetry (bottom layer)
  geom_raster(data = bathy_sea, 
              aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, fill = depth_capped),
              alpha = 0.8) +
  
  # Bathymetry color scale (inverted viridis for shallow = light, deep = dark)
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#f8fbfb", "#67bfbc", "#0f4473", "#0d0f19"),
                     values = c(0, 0.25, 0.75, 1),  # Where each color appears (0=shallow, 1=deep)
                     trans = "sqrt",
                     limits = c(0, 1000),
                     guide = "none") +
  
  # Add new fill scale for land topography
  new_scale_fill() +
  
  # Layer 2: Add marine components as black outlines (middle layer)
  geom_sf(data = marine_components, 
          fill = NA,
          color = "black",
          linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Layer 3: Add topography for land areas (overlays component lines)
  {if(exists("topo_land") && nrow(topo_land) > 0) {
    geom_raster(data = topo_land, 
                aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, fill = elevation_capped),
                alpha = 1)}} +
  
  # Land topography color scale (black for high, grey for flat)
  {if(exists("topo_land") && nrow(topo_land) > 0) {
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#bbbbbb", "gray45", "gray30"),
                     values = c(0, 0.6, 1),  # Where each color appears (0=shallow, 1=deep)
                     trans = "sqrt",
                     limits = c(0, 1000),
                     guide = "none")}} +
    
  geom_sf(data = world,
          fill = NA,
          color = "black",
          linewidth = 0.25) +
  
  # Layer 4: Add component labels (top layer - appears over everything)
  geom_text(data = component_centroids,
            aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = component),
            size = 7, 
            fontface = "bold", 
            color = "black",
            check_overlap = TRUE) +
  
  # Set map extent and projection
  coord_sf(xlim = c(map_extent$lon_min, map_extent$lon_max),
           ylim = c(map_extent$lat_min, map_extent$lat_max),
           crs = 4326,
           expand = FALSE) +
  
  # Clean styling
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))

# Display the map
#print(bathymetric_map)

# Save the map
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "component_map.png"), 
       plot = bathymetric_map,
       width = 15, height = 15, 
       dpi = 300, 
       bg = "white")
```
